Chain rule: after a pair (A, B), the next pair in the chain is the one whose FIRST item is B. Start at otl: the pair (otl, ukq) comes first; its second item is ukq, so the next pair is the one whose first item is ukq: (ukq, ukq). Its second item is ukq, but ukq never appears as a first item - so ukq is the dangling end of the chain.
ANSWER: otl, ukq
